text:
anna: FYI customer on mobile hit weird behavior: chat messages arriving duplicated and out of order after cellular->wifi handoff. repro in our sampleapp.

mike: mobile handoffs + proxy buffering = classic. any auth refresh events?

sam: yes auth refresh happened during the handoff. packet capture shows a partial event (no trailing "\n\n") then the proxy replayed buffered bytes when new conn established. result: fragments of the same message delivered twice.

jess: do we have stable semantics defined across SDKs for multi-chunk SSE payloads? e.g., chunked JSON that needs assembly by event id?

sam: spec-wise we don't force a particular client behavior, but our server sends an "id" per logical message and sometimes splits content across several SSE events for streaming. clients are expected to reassemble.

anna: so two failure modes: 1) client applies fragments from both connections (duplicate apply), 2) client fails to reassemble because chunk boundary split in the middle of JSON string.

mike: which SDKs seen affected? node, go, android?

sam: observed in Node and Go (sampleapps). Android sampleapp had its own heuristics and mostly just dropped the second fragment (inconsistent).

jess: propose fixes: (a) client-side dedupe by event id + sequence number; (b) buffer partial data until valid JSON assembled; (c) add opt-in strict resume mode for mobile SDKs.

anna: agreed on (a) and (b). (c) seems like product/UX decision.

mike: I'll implement Node/Go parser updates: maintain map of in-progress message ids -> partial payload; ignore duplicate fragments if we've already marked id completed. Also add a small ttl to clear stuck partials.

sam: I'll add a flaky-network test harness into sampleapp and a CI job that runs it against the dedicated QA pool. local repro command: 

```
# simulate network change + proxy replay
./sampleapp/run --simulate-handoff --replay-buffer --model gpt-small --seed 7
```

jess: sounds good. Also add a monitoring alert: if we detect >5 dup ids per user/hour, fire an incident.

qa-bot: test job queued: flaky/sse-replay (build 4721).

mike: will open PR after unit tests. Node change: parser now concatenates consecutive data: lines until blank line, try JSON.parse, if fails keep buffered until next data chunk. Also dedupe on id.

anna: please include changelog entry for SDKs and update sampleapp troubleshooting doc. customer reply scheduled.

sam: uploading pcap and short log excerpt to the thread in 10m. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

jess: adding backlog ticket DEVEX-9122 to track cross-sdk parity + alerting.

anna: nice work. keep me posted on ETA for customer response.
